Language test: the rule tested on every system; LANG checked only off Windows [skip ci]

ar: اختبار اللغة: على ويندوز تُقرأ لغة ويندوز نفسها لا متغير LANG، فصار الاختبار يفحص القاعدة مباشرة

The Windows build ran the language test with LANG=ar_SA / fr_FR and got "en": Windows does not read LANG, it reads
its own language (English on the build machine) — the program was right, the test was not. The rule is now one
function, language_of(tag), tested everywhere; the LANG run is skipped on Windows.
